1. Subscription

Printwell is free to download, and using it requires an active subscription. The subscription is offered as an auto-renewable weekly, monthly or yearly plan. The price and period are shown in the app, in your local currency, before you confirm. Prices vary by country.

2. Billing, renewal and free trial

  • Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or, if you start with a free trial, when the trial ends.
  • The monthly plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. When the trial ends, it converts into a paid monthly subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the trial.
  • A subscription renews automatically for the same period unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends.
  • You can manage or cancel subscriptions in iOS Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions, or from Settings › Manage subscription in Printwell. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
  • Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
  • Purchases are linked to your Apple Account. Use Restore purchases in Printwell to unlock your subscription on another device signed in with the same Apple Account.
  • Billing and refunds are handled by Apple under its policies. You can request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com; we cannot issue refunds ourselves.

3. Printers and compatibility

Printwell works with printers and scanners that support standard network printing and scanning protocols (such as AirPrint, IPP and eSCL) on the same network as your device or over Wi‑Fi Direct. We cannot guarantee that every printer model, network or feature works with the app; we recommend trying it during the free trial. Ink, toner and paper information is shown as reported by the printer and may be approximate or unavailable. Print quality, colours and margins depend on your printer, paper and settings.

4. Scans, text recognition and templates

Text recognition (OCR) is automatic and may contain errors; check important text before you rely on it. Templates such as invoices, CVs, certificates and calendars are starting points that you fill in yourself, and you are responsible for their content and for checking any legal or tax requirements that apply to you. Passport and ID photo layouts are printed at the selected size; check the requirements of the authority you submit them to.

5. Use it lawfully

Only print, scan or copy content that you have the right to use. Do not use Printwell to copy banknotes, official documents or copyrighted material where that is not permitted by law.

6. Your content

Your documents, photos, scans and the text recognised from them belong to you. They are stored on your device and we have no access to them, so please keep your own backups of anything important. See the Privacy Policy.

7. Trademarks and independence

Printwell is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by HP, Canon, Epson, Brother or any other printer maker. Brand names are used only to describe compatibility. AirPrint, Apple, iPhone, iPad and App Store are trademarks of Apple Inc.

8. Disclaimers and liability

To the extent permitted by law, Printwell is provided “as is” and “as available”. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for wasted paper, ink or time caused by a printer, network or document problem. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or your statutory rights as a consumer.

9. Changes

We may update these terms, for example when features or plans change. The current version is always published at this address with its effective date. Changes to the price of an existing subscription are handled by Apple, which informs you in advance and asks for your consent where required.
